text:
elaine: quick heads-up — we're retiring the v1 /models and /generate endpoints on 2026-06-15. need docs + comms plan.
raj: timeline ok. can we get small migration snippets for Ruby + Go in the guide? most new customers use TS and Py but some internal teams use Ruby.
marta: I'm working on a docs PR with example app updates. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/241 — added a small ruby snippet for the chat->responses mapping but want review.
kevin: tagging product comms: we need a short changelog blurb + recommended customer email. suggest: "v1 endpoints replaced by consolidated v2 API; no model capability change; update clients by X date." thoughts? :megaphone:
oliver: for rollback safety, recommend including the compatibility shim snippet and a model alias pattern. Example alias strategy: set runtime route to fallback to `redwood/gpt-3.5-legacy` if v2 returns 5xx.
lisa: small link fix: in the migration guide the link to the SDK release notes points to /releases/v1. should change to /releases/v2. I have a quick PR for that.
raj: ruby snippet looks fine but short; add explicit header example for auth. e.g. ```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"
req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
req.body = {model: 'redwood/gpt-4-mini', input: 'Translate to FR: Hello'}.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) { |http| http.request(req) }
puts res.body
```
marta: thanks — added that to PR. also added a short migration checklist at the top: 1) update SDK to v2.x 2) replace /v1/models calls with model param + v2 endpoint 3) run integration tests 4) roll out canary.
kevin: comms draft posted in #announcements draft thread — please +1 before EOD. Also we should prepare a short snippet for the "model swap" dropdown in the Console docs: curl example that switches to the smaller quantized model when latency spikes.
oliver: curl swap example (for docs): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/route-swap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/chat","from":"redwood/gpt-4-full","to":"redwood/gpt-4-small-quant","reason":"latency spike"}'
```
docs-bot: deployed staging build with PR 241 and link fixes — preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/migration/v1-to-v2
lisa: verifying that preview now. found one typo in the changelog blurb: "consolidated" -> "consolidated API" (adds clarity).
elaine: awesome. next steps: marta please merge PR after raj + oliver review, kevin will finalize comms, lisa will update links in the redirects file, i'll schedule the announcement for 2026-05-20 to give customers 4 weeks notice. any blockers?
marta: none from docs side. I'll request reviews now.
raj: ping me after merge, i'll coordinate a small internal postmortem template for teams doing the migration.
kevin: will loop in support and account teams tomorrow. thanks all :raised_hands:
